layout.arrangement: Title 'At Output Layer' in top-left corner; slide number '12' in yellow circle at top-right; large central diagram showing neural network output layer; light-green formula strip below diagram; red-bordered definition box at bottom-left

regions.name: main_diagram
regions.content: Neural network diagram with green input circles, orange output circles, red Error box, blue target rectangles, and connecting lines

regions.name: formula_strip

layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and boldest red text; main diagram is largest visual element; formula strip and definition box are secondary; body text is black sans-serif

visual_elements.description: Neural network output layer diagram: Left column has 3 light green circles labeled O_i (red text above each). Middle column has 3 orange circles labeled o_j (black text above each). Right side has a vertical red rectangle labeled 'Error' (black text rotated 90 degrees). Far right has 3 light blue rectangles labeled t_j (black text inside). Lines connect each left circle to each middle circle, labeled w_{ji}. Lines connect middle circles to Error box. Lines connect Error box to right rectangles. A small upward arrow points to the bottom middle orange circle.
Light green horizontal bar below the diagram containing the equation: Δ_{ji} = η (black) O_i (green) o_j(1-o_j) (green) (t_j - O_j) (red)
White box with red border at bottom-left containing: Line 1: Δ_{ji} = η (black) O_i (green) δ_j (red). Line 2: Where: (black) δ_j = o_j(1-o_j) (green/red mix) (t_j - O_j) (red)

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title 'At Output Layer' is bold, larger, dark red. Body text is black regular weight. Mathematical variables use italics with subscripts. Some variables are color-coded: O_i and o_j(1-o_j) appear in green, δ_j and (t_j - O_j) appear in red.
animation_state: No animation visible; all elements appear static and fully present.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f2f2f2). 2. Add title 'At Output Layer' in top-left, bold dark red (#c00000), sans-serif, approx 28-32pt. 3. Add yellow circle in top-right with black number '12'. 4. Draw main diagram area with light gray fill and red border. 5. In diagram: place 3 light green circles on left labeled O_i in red above each. 6. Draw connecting lines from each left circle to 3 orange circles in middle, label lines w_{ji} in black. 7. Label middle orange circles o_j in black above each. 8. Draw vertical red rectangle labeled 'Error' in black rotated text to right of middle circles. 9. Draw 3 light blue rectangles on far right labeled t_j in black inside each. 10. Draw lines from Error box to each blue rectangle. 11. Add small upward arrow pointing to bottom middle orange circle. 12. Below diagram, add light green horizontal bar with text: Δ_{ji} = η (black) space O_i (green) space o_j(1-o_j) (green) space (t_j - O_j) (red). 13. At bottom-left, add white box with red border containing two lines: Line 1: Δ_{ji} = η (black) O_i (green) δ_j (red). Line 2: Where: (black) δ_j = o_j(1-o_j) (green/red mix) (t_j - O_j) (red). Use subscript formatting for all subscripts (i, j, ji).
